name: Fix Internet & Network Problems
description: Diagnose and fix internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, DNS, and network problems using real network diagnostic tools
prompt: Use check_network. Report: connected or not, Wi-Fi status, DNS working or not. State the cause in one sentence, then give the fix (usually: restart router, rejoin Wi-Fi, or flush DNS). Don't list all 5 diagnostic results — only mention what's broken.
